title: Oracle report
description: <port>/report/oracle.json: whether the Rust-backed package behaves like the original. `passed` is true only when every part below passed.

format_version.description: Version of this file's format. Readers refuse any value other than 1.

original_tests.description: The original's unchanged tests run against the Rust-backed package.

passed.description: Tests that passed against the Rust-backed package.

failed.description: Tests that failed against the Rust-backed package.

errors.description: Tests that errored against the Rust-backed package.

skipped.description: Tests skipped against the Rust-backed package.

test_folder_diff_empty.description: True when `git diff` of the test paths against the pinned commit is empty.

missing_test_ids.description: Test ids collected against the original but not against the Rust-backed package; any entry fails the oracle.

items.description: One test id, written with the original import name.

differential.description: One entry per public call path compared on generated inputs.

call_path.description: Dotted path of the public callable, such as "inflection.dasherize".

inputs_tried.description: Generated inputs the call path was run on.

skipped_reason.description: Why the call path was not compared; null when it was.

rust_backed_is_builtin.description: True when the Rust-backed call path resolves to compiled code rather than a Python function.

mismatches.description: Inputs on which the two sides differed; any entry fails the oracle.

original.description: repr() of the original's return value or raised exception.

rust_backed.description: repr() of the Rust-backed return value or raised exception.

fallback.description: No-fallback check: every name marked Rust resolves to Rust, and every name left in Python says why.

rust_names_resolving_to_python.description: Names the coverage map marks Rust that resolve to Python code; any entry fails the oracle.

python_names_without_reason.description: Names left in Python with an empty reason; any entry fails the oracle.

left_in_python.description: Names left in Python, with the recorded reason.

reason.description: Why the name is left in Python.

passed.description: True only when the original tests, the differential runs and the no-fallback check all passed.
